mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 46 degrees under overcast skies at Verona City Hall, with a Waning Gibbous moon in the phase cycle.

The city has shared important reminders. Winter street parking regulations go into effect from November 20 through April 1, and the Senior Center will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27.
There is plenty to do, including the Main Street Trick-or-Treat today, live music at Bailey's Run today, and the Dane County Farmer's Market taking place tomorrow.
In a noteworthy call from October 23, officers made contact with two 13-year-olds on eMotos, resulting in citations for their parents for permitting a minor to operate a motor vehicle.
Culver's is currently open until 10:30 PM, so stop by today to enjoy the delicious Chocolate Covered Strawberry flavor of the day.
